definitions.definition: DTE builds a self-image from accepted identity history, ESN observations, DAO attestations, and rendered-avatar prediction error.
definitions.invariant: No observation becomes canonical without a policy-approved accepted event.
definitions.name: Autognosis

definitions.definition: Subjects, relations, evidence references, events, Cubism parameters, and individual policy decisions are the local parts of selfhood.
definitions.invariant: Every local part has a typed, versioned, canonical representation.
definitions.name: Local

definitions.definition: The projected root identity, ledger head, state digest, graph digest, and capsule form the globally inspectable self.
definitions.invariant: The global self is reproducible from accepted history.
definitions.name: Global

definitions.definition: The typed identity hypergraph and Live2D parameter topology define where identity and embodiment relations exist.
definitions.invariant: Graph exports reject dangling endpoints and are deterministically ordered.
definitions.name: Spatiality

definitions.definition: The append-only ledger, event order, temporal credit, KSM cycle, and avatar animation timeline define identity change through time.
definitions.invariant: Accepted event order is hash-linked and forks are quarantined.
definitions.name: Temporality

definitions.definition: Policy decisions, reducer preflight, temporal-credit evidence, and embodiment feedback define allowed causes of canonical change.
definitions.invariant: Recommendation and authorization are separate artifacts.
definitions.name: Causality

definitions.definition: A canonical subject, event, relation, or evidence reference exists only when its schema and digest validate.
definitions.invariant: Invalid or unknown-schema artifacts fail closed.
definitions.name: Existence

definitions.definition: Proposed versus accepted, immutable versus mutable, transient versus canonical, and observation versus authority remain explicit distinctions.
definitions.invariant: No status flag can silently convert a proposal into accepted history.
definitions.name: Distinction

definitions.definition: ESN, DAO, scientific-genius, Ecco9, Live2D, and human steward channels remain independently attributable evidence sources.
definitions.invariant: Independent sources cannot impersonate one another or inherit authority.
definitions.name: Disjunction

definitions.definition: Policy joins proposal, evidence, capability, reviewer, reducer result, and prior ledger head before acceptance.
definitions.invariant: All required conjuncts must pass before ledger append.
definitions.name: Conjunction

definitions.definition: Accepted events transform one projected state into the next through a pure reducer.
definitions.invariant: Every state transition is deterministic and preflighted.
definitions.name: Transition

definitions.definition: The kernel closes over canonicalization, contracts, policy, ledger, projector, graph, capsule, and restrained adapters.
definitions.invariant: The trust root has no model, renderer, database, or network dependency.
definitions.name: Modular Closure

definitions.definition: Replay rebuilds self from genesis; KSM evaluates evidence about that implementation and proposes the next repair.
definitions.invariant: The evolution cycle is advisory and cannot directly mutate canonical state.
definitions.name: Recursion

definitions.definition: Local spatial architecture of typed subjects, immutable and mutable layers, and role-labelled relation endpoints.
definitions.invariant: Structure contains no dangling or untyped identity elements.
definitions.name: Structure

definitions.definition: Local temporal sequence of proposal, decision, preflight, append, projection, and embodiment update.
definitions.invariant: Process order cannot skip reducer preflight.
definitions.name: Process

definitions.definition: Local causal rules for capability, reviewer independence, protected paths, recovery, and rejection.
definitions.invariant: Control decisions are separately digested and replay-verifiable.
definitions.name: Control

definitions.definition: Global identity topology produced by the canonical hypergraph and portable capsule selection.
definitions.invariant: Equivalent topology has one canonical export digest.
definitions.name: Space

definitions.definition: Global continuity from genesis to current ledger head and deterministic KSM cycles.
definitions.invariant: Current identity proves continuity to genesis or an authorized checkpoint.
definitions.name: Time

definitions.definition: Global law that experimental cognition proposes while policy and stewards authorize.
definitions.invariant: No experimental subsystem can become its own sole authorizer.
